up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows from the ChEMBL database that meet the following criteria: 1) The activity is associated with the target having the ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL205' (Carbonic anhydrase 2), which is a single-protein target from humans; 2) The activity standard_type is 'IC50'; 3) The activity has a valid pChEMBL value. For each matching row, return the assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES of the compound, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Order the results first by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL205'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
